def redpx(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R': return n['pixels']
    return None
base = redpx(current_frame)
print("start red:", base)
changed = None
for i in range(20):
    action(['DOWN'], intent='solve')
    r = redpx(current_frame)
    if r != base:
        changed = (i+1, r)
        print(f"RED CHANGED after bump {i+1}: {base} -> {r}")
        break
    # also check done/level
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('game_over'):
        print("terminal after bump", i+1, last_action_result)
        break
if changed is None:
    print("no red change after 20 bumps; red now:", redpx(current_frame))
    print("last:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['no_impact','level_completed','done','reward']})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
